newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FOREST TRANSFER-LIST ROY AND JERKAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOREST TRANSFER-LIST ROY AND JERKAN.

text.p: Nottingham Forest have transfer-listed Dutchman Bryan Roy and Croatian Nikola Jerkan following their relegation from the English premier league.
Roy and Jerkan who are both still under contract, have decided to leave the club after discussing their futures with new manager Dave Bassett.
Dutch striker Roy joined Forest three years ago from Italian club Foggia and, although he enjoyed a fine first season at Forest, he has since struggled to make an impact.
He scored just four goals last season and now looks set for a return to his native country, or either Italy or Spain.

Jerkan joined Forest last summer, after helping Croatia reach the quarter-finals of Euro '96 but started only 14 matches following his 1.0 million pounds signing ($1.6 million) from Spanish club Real Oviedo.
